visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor mall walkway with smooth tiled floors. A young boy in a blue sweatshirt runs enthusiastically towards the camera with his arms wide. A woman's hand briefly enters the frame to interact with him. Background features blurry figures of shoppers and retail displays. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a large baseball stadium. A young boy sits in a stadium seat, wearing a blue jersey over his sweatshirt, eating a bun. The background shows a massive crowd and the bright green baseball field under artificial stadium lights. (3) A wide shot captures the baseball field where cheerleaders in white and blue uniforms are performing a synchronized dance routine. The stadium is packed with spectators, and a large electronic scoreboard is visible in the distance. (4) Back in the audience section, the boy is holding a red Pringles can. He pulls out a chip and playfully interacts with the person filming. He smiles at the camera, showing a cheerful expression. (5) A brief shot of the stadium's large jumbotron shows players on the field. The camera then cuts back to a close-up of the boy’s face as he responds to the person filming with a thoughtful expression. (6) The video concludes with a close-up selfie-style shot of a young woman (the creator) wearing a baseball cap and blue jersey alongside the boy. They both cheer with high energy, and the boy tries to lean in to kiss her cheek before the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM. A child's high-pitched, excited voice is heard shouting greetings. Mall-like indoor reverberation is present. (2) A sharp transition introduces stadium sounds—a distant roar of the crowd and percussive drum beats matching a sports chant. The child is heard making soft munching noises while talking. (3) The crowd noise swells significantly with high-arousal cheering and rhythmic clapping. The BGM continues as a steady, high-energy foundation. (4) The BGM shifts to a more playful, lower-tempo melody. A distinct rustling sound of a plastic snack container (Pringles can) is heard. Dialogue between a friendly female voice and the child dominates the foreground. (5) Loud cheering and an announcer's voice on a public address system create a dense acoustic background. The child’s voice remains clear in the foreground, responding to the woman. (6) The video ends with a hyper-dense mix of loud stadium chanting ('Jiayou'), heavy rhythmic percussion, and high-energy vocal interaction between the creator and the child, concluding with a giggle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Interaction -> Observation -> Emotional Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a heartwarming personal vlog documenting a special day out at a professional baseball game between a female creator and a young boy she affectionately calls her 'little boyfriend.' It highlights the excitement of the live sporting event, the charm of the child's reactions, and their playful bond through snacks, cheering, and direct interaction with the camera.
